features: 2MP analog HD PTZ, AHD 1080p output (BNC CVBS SD for installation)
Pan 360 endless, tilt 210 (-15 to 195), preset speed 700/sec
Day & Night (ICR), WDR 120dB, SSDR, SSNR III, DIS, defog
RS-485: Samsung-T/E, Pelco-D/P, Panasonic, Bosch, AD, GE, Vicon, Honeywell
Power 24W max heater off, 65W max heater on
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision user manual (Manuals_HCP-6320,HCP-6320H_180503_EN.pdf, covering HCP-6320 and HCP-6320H). Min. illumination recorded at 30IRE, 1/30sec, F1.6 (manual also lists 50IRE and 2sec slow-shutter values). Frame rate not stated. consumption_w is the max with heater on (24W heater off).
